LESSON: JOHN THE BAPTIST TO THE MESSIAH

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Early life of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.2: John the Baptist to the Messiah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about John the Baptist to the Messiah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How is John the Baptist a precursor to the Messiah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. elaborate the annunciation and birth of John the Baptist
2. relate the birth of John the Baptist to the coming of the
3. interpret John’s description of the and John 1:-

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. elaborate the annunciation and birth of John the Baptist
   In simple words: practise until you can elaborate the annunciation and birth of John the Baptist. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. relate the birth of John the Baptist to the coming of the
   In simple words: practise until you can relate the birth of John the Baptist to the coming of the. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. interpret John’s description of the and John 1:-
   In simple words: practise until you can interpret John’s description of the and John 1:-. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about John the Baptist to the Messiah using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about John the Baptist to the Messiah in the examples.
2. Explain John the Baptist to the Messiah to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand John the Baptist to the Messiah.
4. Show that you can: elaborate the annunciation and birth of John the Baptist

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about John the Baptist to the Messiah using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is John the Baptist to the Messiah important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Luke 1:5-25 on the annunciation of the birth of John the Baptist and retell the story,
2. Read Luke 1:57-66 and make short notes on the birth of John the Baptist,
3. Role-play the annunciation of John the Baptist and record it using a digital device,
4. Read Luke 3:16 and John 1:29-30 and write the main points on flash cards,
5. Read Luke 3:7-18 and discuss the message of John the Baptist,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. elaborate the annunciation and birth of John the Baptist
2. relate the birth of John the Baptist to the coming of the
3. interpret John’s description of the and John 1:-
